purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Chongqing’s official bureau states that registered-property and cadastral-map records can be queried online through YukuaiBan or service halls under defined access conditions. An earlier official visual-map pilot was limited to Liangjiang New Area, not Wanzhou. The Wanzhou government portal links the general government service platform; no point-based public parcel geometry service for Wanzhou was exposed. No address, title, rights-holder, or owner query was made.
registryAssessment: Chongqing land-registration services apply at municipal level, and Wanzhou has a district government-service entry; the explicitly documented visual map pilot was Liangjiang only. No Wanzhou point/bbox parcel coverage is claimed.
